plugins.name: zcode-web-search
plugins.description: Web search + page fetching for ZCode (Exa, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Kagi, Firecrawl, AnySearch, Perplexity, Serper, keyless fallback). web_search fans out to Exa, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Kagi, Firecrawl, AnySearch, Perplexity, Serper (parallel merge with provider: all) with keyless fallback; fetch_content chains TinyFish Fetch -> Firecrawl -> Jina Reader. Reuses pi-web-access config (~/.pi/web-search.json) when present.
